headlines.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Brings Fans Closer to The World’s Game With New Partners, Leagues, and Stadiums
headlines.summary: REDWOOD CITY, Calif., September 02, 2026--Today, Electronic Arts announced an expanded roster of leagues, clubs, partners and stadiums coming to EA SPORTS FC 27, bringing players closer to the football they love through one of the most authentic representations of The World’s Game.

headlines.title: Will EA’s €250 Million Bundesliga Rights Deal Reshape Its Live-Services Football Narrative (EA)?
headlines.summary: Electronic Arts has entered a multi-year €250 million licensing agreement with Germany's Bundesliga, securing rights to all 36 clubs across the top two leagues for authentic use of images, logos, and player likenesses in its football games. This deal deepens EA's access to officially licensed German football content, potentially reinforcing the appeal of its football franchise against competing titles.

headlines.title: Is Electronic Arts (EA) Pricey Following The Madden NFL 27 Launch?
headlines.summary: How the Madden NFL 27 launch frames Electronic Arts stock today The global release of Madden NFL 27 is a useful starting point if you are looking at Electronic Arts (EA) stock today. The launch helps highlight how its flagship sports franchises feed into investor expectations. headlines.title: Star Wars Zero Company™ Now Available On PC, PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series Consoles
headlines.summary: REDWOOD CITY, Calif., August 27, 2026--Electronic Arts Inc. and Bit Reactor, in collaboration with Lucasfilm Games, announced today that Star Wars Zero Company™, a single-player turn-based tactics game set in the twilight of the Clone Wars™, is now available for PC via the EA app, Steam, and Epic Games Store, and PlayStation®5 and XBOX Series consoles.

description: Electronic Arts Inc. develops, markets, publishes, and delivers games, content, and services for game consoles, PCs, and mobile phones worldwide. It develops and publishes games and experiences across diverse genres, such as sports, racing, first-person shooter, action, role-playing, and simulation; and live services offerings, including extra content and subscription offerings through its global football and American football franchises, such as EA SPORTS College Football and EA SPORTS Madden NFL, as well as based on its IP comprising The Sims, Apex Legends, and Battlefield. The company markets and sells its games and services through digital distribution and retail channels; and directly to mass market retailers, specialty stores, and distribution arrangements. Electronic Arts Inc. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Redwood City, California.
